text:
marco: heads up — saw invoice-preview counts drop to zero briefly for a cluster of tenants during last SKU rollout. console showed an accrual gap then recovery (~45s). filing here for triage.

pri: sample tenant and trace? guessing route rebind + quota-heartbeat TTL race.

marco: tenant=papertrail, trace=tr-cc9. ingest snippet: ```
2025-07-21T12:17:12Z INFO route-resolver bind sku=stable-ap -> route:r99
2025-07-21T12:17:13Z WARN quota-heartbeat missing tenant=papertrail window=30s
2025-07-21T12:17:14Z INFO metering-event tokens=87 route=r99 fingerprint=fp-cc9 session=s-42
```

claire: dedupe key in preview path is `tenant|fingerprint|route_resolution_id`. when route_resolution_id flips mid-session preview accrual can mis-order and show transient zeros. the finalize/accrual pipeline later produces correct invoices.

pm-zoe: product insists on per-SKU preview visibility. we can't flip to a global dedupe that drops route metadata. customers rely on SKU-level early signals.

pri: suggestion: implement a small preview-shim at ingest that emits a canonical_preview_route for events within the same session when a route flip happens within a short TTL (we'll call it the "accrual-shim"). preview dedupe uses canonical_preview_route; final billing stays unchanged.

marco: nice name. how would it behave exactly?

claire: behavior proposal: when ingest sees tenant+session+fingerprint and a new route within TTL=75s, write alias relation to ephemeral alias ledger: observed->canonical (canonical=first-seen route). emit event field `preview_canonical_route` and a boolean `preview_canonical=true`. preview dedupe resolves via that field. pseudocode: ```
key = tenant+"|"+session+"|"+fingerprint
if alias_map[key] && now < alias_map[key].expires and alias_map[key].canonical != observed_route:
  emit.preview_route = alias_map[key].canonical
else:
  alias_map[key] = {canonical: observed_route, expires: now + TTL}
  emit.preview_route = observed_route
```

pri: important: limit scope — only apply to preview UI/tallying (preview shard). billing/ledger path must keep strict route ids. also add audit logs for every alias emission.

telemetry-bot: METRIC: heartbeat-jitter spike 12:15-12:20 (dash link). ingest-bot: NOTICE partition-8 consumer-lag 12:15-12:19 max=16s.

sre-bot: suppressed alert during deploy window. runbook references routing-rebind-rollout.

marco: risks? we might accidentally collapse legitimate retries across route variants. mitigation: only canonicalize when session_id present, fingerprint unchanged, and timestamps within TTL. add unit tests for retry scenarios.

pm-zoe: add UX: console tooltip on invoice-preview: "Preview groups very short-lived route changes to reduce noise; final invoices use exact route ids." and a temporary banner during canary. product wants explicit wording.

claire: telemetry plan: emit `accrual_shim_alias` event with tags {tenant,fingerprint,session,observed,canonical} and metric `accrual_shim_alias_count` per tenant. dashboard: add small sparkline on preview panel showing alias rate.

pri: rollout plan: behind flag `accrual_shim_preview`. canary 2% of tenants for 2h. monitor `invoice_preview_gap_pct`, `accrual_shim_alias_count`, and final billing diffs. expand to 20% then global if safe.

marco: QA: unit tests for alias map TTL and collision, integration test across ingest->preview->finalize ensuring billing unchanged, and chaos test with delayed heartbeats.

claire: I'll open PR with the shim and tests. pri, can you own telemetry + dashboard tile? pm-zoe please draft tooltip copy.

pm-zoe: will prepare tooltip copy and notify EAP customers for canary window. prefer language: "Preview groups transient route changes for clarity; invoices are not changed."

pri: tagging @eng-platform for canary watch. thanks, team — this should cut down preview noise and support tickets.
